evidence_provenance.schema:
CREATE TABLE evidence_provenance (
	evidence_source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	run_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	observation_kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	analyzer VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	captured_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (evidence_source_id), 
	UNIQUE (evidence_source_id, run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_source_id) REFERENCES evidence_sources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES analysis_runs (id)
)

evidence_sources.schema:
CREATE TABLE evidence_sources (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	app_id INTEGER, 
	source_type VARCHAR, 
	evidence_category VARCHAR, 
	data_type VARCHAR, 
	description TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	severity VARCHAR, 
	raw_evidence TEXT, 
	file_reference VARCHAR, 
	line_number INTEGER, 
	timestamp VARCHAR, 
	is_confirmed BOOLEAN, 
	confirmed_by TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES app_analyses (id)
)

finding_assessments.schema:
CREATE TABLE finding_assessments (
	finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	run_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	semantic_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_strength_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	semantic_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (finding_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(finding_id, run_id) REFERENCES risk_findings (id, run_id), 
	UNIQUE (run_id, semantic_id), 
	CHECK (evidence_strength_score >= 0 AND evidence_strength_score <= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES fusion_runs (run_id)
)

finding_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE finding_evidence (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	run_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	evidence_source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	relationship VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(finding_id, run_id) REFERENCES risk_findings (id, run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_source_id, run_id) REFERENCES evidence_provenance (evidence_source_id, run_id), 
	CHECK (relationship IN ('SUPPORTS', 'CORROBORATES', 'CONTRADICTS')), 
	UNIQUE (finding_id, evidence_source_id, relationship)
)

fusion_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE fusion_runs (
	run_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	analysis_configuration_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ontology_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	rule_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	bundle_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	bundle_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_input_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	semantic_output_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	replay_of_run_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES analysis_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_configuration_id) REFERENCES analysis_configurations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(replay_of_run_id) REFERENCES fusion_runs (run_id)
)
